top_signals.title: Anthropic Crypto Bets Imply $1.7 Trillion Despite AI Rout
top_signals.summary: Crypto futures tied to Anthropic’s stock market debut have fallen alongside artificial intelligence stocks, but they still imply a blockbuster valuation of about $1.7 trillion, well above the $1.4 trillion the company would be worth at the top of its proposed initial public offering range.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: World Bank partners with Circle, Citi to explore stablecoins for payments
top_signals.summary: The initiative builds on the World Bank’s existing blockchain platform, which aims to create more fund traceability for investments in developing countries.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: BASF’s Evonik Chase Poses Test for Potential Merz Successor
top_signals.summary: BASF SE’s bid to consolidate Germany’s struggling chemicals industry with a takeover of Evonik Industries AG looks set to join the ranks of politically-charged deals taking shape across Europe this year.

top_signals.title: Bloomberg Global Credit Forum: Where Do Debt Markets Go From Here? Live Updates
top_signals.summary: With credit markets at an inflection point, the industry’s most influential voices gather in London for Bloomberg’s Global Credit Forum 2026.

top_signals.title: DBS lets eligible institutions in Asia mint and redeem USDC around the clock
top_signals.summary: DBS and Circle are expanding institutional access to USDC with direct minting, redemption and 24/7 dollar settlement.
